purpose: projection-specific fixed whole-row placement without CR
candidate_rule: Each layer/phase chooses the lowest training mean among equal g16, existing trained whole-row g1/2/4/8/16 groups (w4 only), and the train-only wave-aligned row template. Ties prefer equal g16.
evaluation_scope: routed FFN projection service, not full-model latency
reused_test_warning: The corpus test was used by earlier studies and its aggregate results were already known when proposing this method. This is exploratory fixed-test reuse, not a new blind confirmation.
hardware: 16 chips, 4 same-context planes/chip, 16KiB pages, 28us ordinary read, 6.4GB/s chip, 250ns/block-shard command, 2us/host phase; input INT8/output FP32
dependency: gate_up -> host reassembly and activation -> down; no inter-layer or next-token overlap
unmeasured: host row reassembly, activation/combine compute, physical PE/NAND and FTL
